subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.
stimulus: take eat deserve be thrive cause run know fall do Everybody (a) _____that food adulteration (b) _____ a crime. Adulterated food is poisonous and (c) _____ diseases. People (d) _____this kind of food (e) _____ victim to liver disease, cancer, kidney failure and so on. Some businessmen who are avaricious and (f) _____ after money only (g) _____ this heinous work. They (h) _____ on the miseries of others. They (i) _____ punishment. Some strict measures should be (j) _____ to stop this abominable task of this greedy businessmen.
guide_solution: (a) knows (b) is (c) causes (d) eating (e) fall (f) run (g) do (h) thrive (i) deserve (j) taken
